title: When the tail is earned by its companions: measuring label dependence in long-tailed multi-label classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.22859v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A rare label seldom occurs alone, and a classifier can recover it from the frequent labels it co-occurs with, its companions, without having learned the label itself. Existing diagnostics of this need a trained model: none says before training whether a corpus admits the failure, or what the standard aggregate hides. Macro-F1, like any measure built from per-label confusion counts, is unchanged by how a label's recall divides between occurrences with and without a companion. We introduce a within-label estimand of that division, a reading rule under which a fall in dependence counts only if companion-free recall rises, and a statistic of training labels that bounds, before training, how far reported recall can exceed companion-free recall. Across 23 corpora, 7 training objectives and five families of label-correlation mechanisms, companion-free recall falls short on all six corpora where the estimand is defined. Up to 18.4% of the tail

translated_title: 当尾部由其伴生标签挣得：测量长尾多标签分类中的标签依赖性
translated_abstract: 稀有标签很少单独出现，分类器可以从与其共现的频繁标签（即其“伴生标签”）中恢复出该稀有标签，而无需真正学到这个标签本身。现有的诊断方法都需要已训练好的模型：没有一种方法能在训练前判断某个语料库是否会出现这种失效，也无法揭示标准聚合指标所掩盖的问题。Macro-F1，以及任何基于逐标签混淆计数构建的度量，都不会因标签召回率在“有伴生标签出现”与“无伴生标签出现”两种情形之间的分配方式不同而改变。我们引入了刻画这种划分的标签内估计量，提出了一种读取规则（在该规则下，只有当无伴生召回率上升时，依赖性的下降才会被计入），并提出一个基于训练标签的统计量，它能够在训练之前界定报告召回率可能超过无伴生召回率的程度。在23个语料库、7种训练目标和五类标签相关机制上的实验表明，在定义了该估计量的全部六个语料库中，无伴生召回率均存在不足，长尾部分中高达18.4%的（召回）……
tldr: 该论文提出了可在训练前评估标签依赖性的标签内估计量、读取规则与统计量，揭示稀有标签的召回表现依赖频繁伴生标签而非模型真正学到稀有标签本身的现象。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a within-label estimand, a reading rule, and a training-label statistic that bound, before training, how much reported rare-label recall depends on frequent companion labels rather than on actually learning the rare label, revealing that companion-free recall falls short across benchmarks.
